scope: Same seven development excerpts; 130 reference melody events and 38 chord labels. Not held-out.

experiments.name: Chord OCR with fixed-melody assumption
experiments.worker_summary: Implemented and ran conservative enlarged-image chord OCR with strict harmony conversion. Seven outputs contain 15 accepted OCR chord candidates; these are not verified matches. All seven enlarged Audiveris melody baselines were unavailable, so melody preservation and non-regression could not be verified; incomplete outputs count as failures. Synthetic chord round-trip, root/slash-bass transposition, kern parsing and melody transposition checks passed. Protected transcription metrics were unavailable, so improvement over baseline is unmeasured. Timing remains unaudited. Goal unmet.

experiments.name: Fresh Audiveris + chord integration
experiments.worker_summary: Integration failed within budget. Retained parent chord OCR unchanged and implemented fresh Audiveris execution, melody conversion and validation paths. Java/native-library startup failures prevented MusicXML exports for all seven images; all seven outputs are explicitly marked failure placeholders, with no invented melody. Complete-file parsing and transposition on recognized melody could not be tested. Per-image diagnostics record these failures. Parent checks validated syntax and synthetic examples rather than complete generated transcriptions; the exact protected-reader failure remains unconfirmed. Chord onset alignment remains unaudited. Protected error comparisons are unavailable, so no improvement or non-regression is claimed. Goal unmet.

experiments.name: Bounded Java/native-library repair
experiments.worker_summary: Preflight failed: restoring Java 25.0.5 and Audiveris 5.11.0 exposed java.lang.UnsatisfiedLinkError: Unable to load library 'gtk-3'; libgtk-3.so was missing. No MusicXML export or predictions were produced. Preserved launch commands, runtime diagnostics and exact exception. OCR thresholds and melody conversion remain unchanged. Complete-file parsing and transposition of actual notes, chord roots and slash basses remain untested; chord timing remains unaudited. Goal unmet; no musical improvement claimed.

experiments.name: Targeted GTK repair
experiments.worker_summary: GTK native loading succeeded after rootless extraction of Debian 13 arm64 packages: libgtk-3-0t64 and libgtk-3-common 3.24.49-3, with libglib2.0-0t64 2.84.4-3~deb13u5. A fresh Python process loaded libgtk-3.so.0 and queried its runtime version. System installation was blocked by apt lock-directory permissions. The export wrapper then raised subprocess.TimeoutExpired after its remaining 3.4308305588069743 seconds; the original 240-second deadline expired at 240.016 seconds. No MusicXML export or kern predictions were produced. This verifies native loading through ctypes, not successful Java/Audiveris integration; no subsequent native blocker was established. Existing Java 25/Audiveris 5.11 configuration, OCR thresholds and melody conversion were retained. All seven required predictions remain missing and count as failures. Complete-output parsing and actual-output major-second transposition checks for melody, chord roots and slash basses remain untested. Chord timing remains unaudited. No musical improvement or regression rate was measured; the transcription goal remains unmet.

findings.partial_chord_label_improvement: Errors 30 -> 25; matches 8 -> 13, but melody regressed and 0/7 files parsed.

observed_limitations: Initial worker assignment required baseline melody artifacts that were not supplied.
Child branches inherited source/configuration but not installed runtimes, dependencies or all diagnostics.
Repeated runtime repairs consumed all four experiment slots; no alternate recognition family was tested.
Local syntax/synthetic checks initially failed to detect missing melody; protected evaluation rejected the result.
interpretation: The coordinator reacted to measured failures and narrowed assignments, but this run does not establish successful self-improvement or a useful end-to-end transcription system.
